The '''Dreaming Waters''' was a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] located to the north of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the [[Quesoth]] [[bowlcarrier]] [[Trevik]], who carried a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for the ruler of the [[City/Legends|city]], the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]], believed the sky looked odd one [[Standard day/Legends|morning]]. As his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] could not see through the mists rising from the Dreaming Waters, he could not determine if [[Cloud/Legends|clouds]] were causing the phenomenon, which led him to believe that the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] ally, the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], had made it look that way.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dreaming Waters was mentioned in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
